propertySets.name: Pset_RailwayTrackStructurePart
propertySets.definition: Properties applicable to IfcRailwayPart with PredefinedType set to TRACK, or more specialized types including PLAINTRACK, TURNOUTTRACK, DILATATIONTRACK or TRACKPART.

properties.name: HasBallastTrack
properties.definition: Indicates whether the track has ballast or not.

properties.name: HasCWR
properties.definition: Indicates if the track has continuous welded rails.

properties.name: IsSunExposed
properties.definition: Indicates if the object is in exposed position to sunshine.

properties.name: TrackSupportingStructure
properties.definition: Indicates the supporting structure for track part.
